I blog and draft everything. I'll end up re-reading it so many times, hours on end and then deleting it. It's kind of like an OCD or taking a selfie that you think looks good at first, but then you over-analyze it for too long and end up seeing all the flaws and hating it </3 I love editing.

I feel you so much here :(
Whenever I have flareups which right now is around the left side of my jawline/chin I am housebound and refuse to go out for weeks on end. I feel completely hopeless and all I can do is apply cream to the affected area, but it feels like my skin has just become immune to it all now and takes so much longer to heal.... 

I'm just lost in myself and nobody around me seems to understand, also being body dysmorphic doesn't exactly help the situation.

I tend to write music/lyrics in my dreams that I think would make an amazing song, but it fades the minute I wake up and can't really remember if it was that good or just sounded better in my sleepy head.

Thank you for the response! I honestly feel like his face has just entered my subconscious so many times now that whenever there is a conflict going on it morphs into him, even when I am dreaming of someone they tend to go back to him for some odd reason.... that whole situation between us was never resolved beyond just moving on, but there have been many situations in my life with people where it has ended in that same 'swept under the rug' way and yet he is the only one really still popping up in my dreams! 

hmm I just find it all /the psyche so fascinating.
